tooltip.longhuan.longhuan_doll: A little companion in your palm.
tooltip.longhuan.controls: Place on blocks. Click display to spin; sneak-click to retrieve. Fits helmet slot. Sneak-use in air to deploy. Click companion to pat; sneak-click to reclaim. Left click a placed doll or companion to dance with mobs within 8 blocks.
message.longhuan.full: Make room in your inventory first.
message.longhuan.owner: This doll belongs to another player.
